text:
nina: Noticed repeated 99.95 tail spikes tonight in us-west1 around 02:10. Heatmap points to shelf-09; pcie retransmits + DMA spikes.
rahul: I pulled node logs. `dmesg` shows occasional pcie link errors then recoveries, likely from heavy NVMe+NVLink bursts.
jesse: Which jobs are active? Could be prefill warmups + nightly bench runs.
toni: Traces show warmup workers from tenants t-900 and t-901 launching parallel prefill slices during the spike window. Also a bench job `bench/net-throughput` scheduled at 02:00.
nina: So a coordination problem: warmup + bench IO causing shelf-level contention and noisy neighbor effects.
rahul: Short-term mitigation idea: mark shelf-09 as `warmup-avoid` and reduce warmup concurrency in the region. That avoids touching prod.
jesse: Alternative: throttle bench jobs or move bench fleet to a different maintenance window. Bench is internal, so low friction.
toni: I'd prefer moving bench for tonight and apply a conservative warmup throttle. Low risk.
opsbot: action: set-config prefill-controller --region=us-west1 --max-concurrent-warmups=3 (requested by @nina)
rahul: Applied. Also added a temporary node-annotation to shelf-09: `avoid-warmup=true` so allocator will not place warmups there.
jesse: Can we add a heuristic to allocator: when PCIe retransmit rate > X, deprioritize warmup job placement? That would help automated avoidance.
rahul: We can emit a signal. But need to be careful with oscillation if signal bounces. Maybe a 5m hysteresis window.
toni: Agreed. Put on follow-up list: `allocator-pcie-signal` RFC. I'll draft it. Include hysteresis and fallback to global throttling.
nina: For now, metrics look better after throttle. pcie tail down ~50% and prod slices stable.
opsbot: deploybot: config change applied to 2 controllers in us-west1.
jesse: Postmortem item: label bench jobs with `low-priority-io` so we can schedule them on less contended shelves.
rahul: I'll open INC-2026-221 and assign to myself for the allocator signal spike and bench-schedule change.
toni: I'll coordinate with SRE to pick 2 warmup-shelf candidates in us-west1 and run cost sims for reserving them.
nina: Thanks. Leaving the throttle in place overnight and will monitor in the morning.
